title: pullAndRefresh remains non-nonReentrant, exposing cross-frame budget double-counting via a malicious/upgraded dispatcher
description:
`pullAndRefresh()` is external, permissionless (subject only to `ownerOrNotGriefed`), and calls `_syncBudget` → `dispatcherHook.pull()` before crediting budget from a `balanceOf` delta. `pullAndRefresh` carries NO `nonReentrant` modifier. The dispatcher address is mutable and explicitly described as upgradeable.

A malicious, buggy, or upgraded dispatcher can reenter `pullAndRefresh` from inside its own `pull()`. In the nested frame, `_syncBudget` pulls again and credits the additional inflow to `rewardBudget`. On return to the outer frame, `inflow = balanceOf(this) - outerPre` includes the nested-frame inflow — double-counting it into `rewardBudget`. Guarded user entrypoints (stake/unstake/claim) are protected by their own `nonReentrant`, but reward emissions can still be corrupted via `pullAndRefresh`.
impact: If the dispatcher hook is ever compromised or adversarially upgraded, `rewardBudget` can be double-credited per reentrant call, inflating emission rate or over-reporting budget. Dependency on the dispatcher-trust assumption; flagged because the hook is explicitly described as a mutable sibling that can be upgraded.
proof: (1) Attacker-controlled dispatcher set via `setDispatcherHook`. (2) Attacker calls `pullAndRefresh`. (3) Outer frame: `outerPre = balanceOf(this)`; `dispatcherHook.pull()` transfers X and reenters `pullAndRefresh`. (4) Nested frame: `nestedPre = outerPre + X`; nested `pull()` transfers Y; nested computes `inflow = Y`, `rewardBudget += Y`, resets windowEnd/rate. (5) Nested returns. Outer: `inflow = balanceOf(this) - outerPre = X + Y`, `rewardBudget += X + Y`. Total credited: `X + 2Y` on top of original.
suggested-fix: Add `nonReentrant` to `pullAndRefresh`. Additionally, consider adding a reentrancy guard to `_syncBudget` itself, or refactor so the inflow is sourced from a return value of `dispatcherHook.pull()` rather than a balance delta — removing the TOCTOU window. A cleaner interface would make the hook's return semantics part of the contract rather than relying on balance-sniffing.
consolidation-note: No overlap in ES findings. Standalone.
